ah.accuracy: Sleep, heart and energy numbers come from your devices and their makers' own estimates. LifePass doesn't measure or check them, and they are not medical advice. If a number doesn't match how you feel, trust how you feel.
ah.brand.apple_watch: Apple Watch sends everything to Apple Health on its own.
ah.brand.coros: In the COROS app, open Profile, then Settings, then Third-Party Apps, then Apple Health.
ah.brand.fitbit: In the Fitbit or Google Health app, look for Apple Health under settings and turn on sharing.
ah.brand.garmin: In Garmin Connect, open Settings, then Connected Apps, then Apple Health, and turn on what to share.
ah.brand.oura: In the Oura app, open Settings, then Apple Health, and allow Oura to write data.
ah.brand.polar: In Polar Flow, open General settings, then Apple Health, and connect.
ah.brand.suunto: In the Suunto app, open Settings, then Connected services, then Apple Health. Open the Suunto app now and then so it syncs.
ah.brand.whoop: In the WHOOP app, open the menu, then Integrations, then Apple Health. Recovery and HRV scores stay in WHOOP.
ah.brand.withings: In Withings Health Mate, open Settings, then Health apps, then Apple Health. Open the Withings app now and then so it syncs.
ah.brands.sub: Most apps can send their data to Apple Health. Turn that on once in the maker's app. Menu names can differ between app versions.

healthconsent.ai.body: Plans and meal estimates are made with Anthropic, our AI provider, which may process data in the United States. Before anything is sent, we take out who you are.
healthconsent.ai.describe: A meal you describe goes to Anthropic only to make the estimate. We don't keep your words, only the foods you save.
healthconsent.ai.kicker: What the AI sees for plans and meals
healthconsent.ai.never_identity: Never your name, email, kennitala or account details
healthconsent.ai.never_location: Never your location with a plan or a meal. Meal photos are made smaller on your phone and lose hidden details such as where and when they were taken.
healthconsent.ai.never_numbers: Never your exact weight, height or age, only ranges such as 25 to 34
healthconsent.ai.never_text: Never notes or anything you type for a plan. Coach chat messages are sent as you write them, so leave health details out of chat.
healthconsent.ai.never_text_v4: Never notes or anything you type when a plan is made, apart from a change you ask the Coach to make (below). Coach chat messages are sent as you write them, so leave health details out of chat.
healthconsent.ai.photo: A meal photo goes to Anthropic only to make the estimate. Anthropic may not train on it and deletes it within 30 days, apart from the exceptions in our privacy policy.
healthconsent.ai.plan_edit: If you ask the Coach to change your workout plan, your words and the plan (its exercises, sets and rest, and the names and notes you wrote for your own exercises) go to Anthropic only to make the change. Never your safety answers, body measurements or dates, and never your name, email or any account ID. Anthropic may not train on them and deletes them within 30 days, apart from the exceptions in our privacy policy. We don't keep your words. A change you apply is kept with your plan, including the names and notes you wrote for your own exercises, and a suggestion you don't apply is deleted within 24 hours.
healthconsent.ai.saved_once: Every plan and estimate is saved in your account, so each one is made only once.
